behaviors.action: Enter an invalid numeric expression, attempt Save, then press Escape and save again.
behaviors.expected: The invalid draft remains visible and blocks the first save; Escape restores the saved value.

behaviors.action: Drag an inspector slider for more than two seconds, release it and undo once.
behaviors.expected: One Undo restores the pre-drag value. Separate fields remain separate history entries.

behaviors.action: Import a short WAV in Audio mixer, add a loop region, edit an endpoint past the other endpoint, then correct it.
behaviors.expected: The invalid draft does not remove the loop region; the corrected value persists through save/reopen.

behaviors.action: In Settings choose Automatic or Above controls labels, enlarge text to 200%, and focus a long dropdown value.
behaviors.expected: Labels stack and the full selected value appears in a wrapping tooltip without changing project data.

behaviors.action: Edit Player X and Y rapidly, then undo twice, redo, save/reopen and export.
behaviors.expected: Each field is independently undoable; saved and exported positions agree.

behaviors.action: Play the game with WASD/arrow keys; collect six checkpoints in order and press R to restart.
behaviors.expected: Movement, checkpoint progression and restart work in the editor and exported player.

behaviors.action: Change speed in the matching Code, Blocks or Mixed workflow, undo/redo, save/reopen and export Web.
behaviors.expected: Supported graph/code conversion and the authored speed remain equivalent in the exported game.

behaviors.action: Open Rendering → Quality. Compare Auto/MSAA4 and resolution scales1/1.5; keep all animations and effects enabled.
behaviors.expected: Actual pixel/sample counters explain the device result. Higher scale increases backing pixels within bounds; no gameplay or animation system is removed.

behaviors.action: Change the editor palette through Settings; switch light/dark and reopen.
behaviors.expected: Editor colors persist independently of game colors and saved project rendering settings.
